pages.text: Close a wound. Heals $(cfg)2$() times faster and stays closed. Medicine 3.

Minigame: pull the needle from a point to its pair across the wound without drifting. When all stitches are done — $(l)pull the edges together$(): hold LMB until they meet and release. Too hard — the tissue tears.
A suture does not stop arterial bleeding — that is vascular surgery. Remove sutures with scissors.
